title: Museum of Holocaust Art, Yad Vashem
source: Three labelled ordinary official exterior photos and campus aerial actually viewed; existing standard PMTiles/Mapzen controls.

reconstruction.heightBasis: No map height exists. Picture-led working courtyard wall/roof height6.8m, portal4.2m tall and3.8m wide/depth2.32m, recessed side doors2.6m tall, parapet0.35m. Hidden rear/roof and underground galleries are not verified. The roof uses a light shared gravel substitute; planted upper terraces, irrigation, roof gardens and actual roof services are not reconstructed. Banner is a plain colour cue without copied art, text or inscriptions.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Standard PMTiles and Terrarium supply the retained approach and the shared terrain datum. An open limestone court occupies the photographed inner square. Its two pavement sections meet on the same plane. The mapped road, upper plaza, stair approaches and the original heightfield are retained beyond the two cutout outlines.
